name: Borja Giménez Larraz - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text:
**What this report asks for**

This is the European Parliament's opinion, not a new law. It calls for an EU plan to make housing more affordable. It wants faster building permits, less red tape, more money for social and affordable homes, and help for young people and first-time buyers. It also asks for rules on short-term holiday rentals and better protection for both tenants and owners. Housing policy stays mainly with national and local governments.

**Key points**

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission to act, for example with a housing simplification package and an EU housing plan.
- **Who it affects:** People struggling with rent or buying, young people, tenants, owners, builders and local councils.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to propose laws. Parliament also wants an EU housing summit and better housing data.
